Question 4
?

Find the equation of the normal line to the surface x2+y2+z2=3 at the point (−1,−1,1).

a
x+1=y+1=z−1
b
x+1=y+1=z−1−1
c
x+1=y−1=z−1
d
x+1=y+1=z+1−1
e
x−1=y+1=z−1−1
